name: generate_audio
description: Generate audio. Use `sonilo_music` for music, `mirelo_text_to_audio` for sound effects, and `inworld_text_to_speech` for spoken text. Pass top-level model, prompt, voice for inworld_text_to_speech, and duration only when the selected model declares duration. Do not pass provider-specific keys such as text, text_prompt, upload_audio_format, num_samples, seed, double_output, or ambience. Audio generation is single-sample. get_cost:true preflights credits.

model.description: Audio model ID from the model catalog (required). Use models_explore(type:'audio') to discover.

prompt.description: Text prompt for the generated audio.

voice.description: Voice for inworld_text_to_speech. Use models_explore(type:'audio') to inspect allowed values.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Required for sonilo_music and mirelo_text_to_audio; omit for inworld_text_to_speech.

get_cost.description: If true, return the cost in credits for this generation without submitting any job. Use to preflight cost before generating.
